blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
IT supports every Czarnikow office, from London to São Paulo. When your computer has a problem, the IT team is there to help.

In this lesson, "Save and Send", you learn the everyday English you need. You use it when you talk to the help desk or join an online meeting. The words are simple and useful: save, send, open, close, and share.

Take it slow. One step at a time. Save your work first, check it, and then share it. Small good habits today protect the whole company tomorrow. You can do it!

items.q: Which offices does IT support?
items.why: "IT supports every Czarnikow office, from London to São Paulo."

items.q: When do you use this everyday English?
options: When you write a long report
When you talk to the help desk or join an online meeting
items.why: "You use it when you talk to the help desk or join an online meeting."

items.q: What should you do FIRST with your work?
items.why: "Save your work first, check it, and then share it."

items.q: The text suggests that small good habits are…
items.why: Inferência: "Small good habits today protect the whole company tomorrow" mostra que ajudam a todos.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: you should learn one step at a time
you should do everything very fast
IT is not needed at Czarnikow
you should never ask the help desk
items.why: Inferência: "Take it slow. One step at a time" mostra que o autor prefere calma e passos pequenos.

blocks.instruction: Ouça James explicar um fluxo de trabalho seguro. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, everyone. Today I want to show you a safe way to work with your files. It is very simple, so don't worry.

First, save your work. This is the most important step. When you save often, you never lose your work. I like to save every few minutes.

Next, open the file again and check it. Read it one more time. Is everything correct? Are the numbers right? Take your time here.

Then you can share the file with your team. Use the shared drive, not your email. It is faster and safer for everybody.

Finally, send the message and close the file. When you close it, save it one last time, just in case.

Remember: save first, check, share, and send. If something looks strange, call the help desk. Our IT team is small, but we are very quick. You can always ask us. Thank you, and have a good day.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is the most important step, according to James?
items.why: "First, save your work. This is the most important step."

items.q: How does James want you to share a file?
items.why: "Use the shared drive, not your email."

items.q: What should you do when you close the file?
items.why: "When you close it, save it one last time, just in case."

items.q: James says "Take your time here." This suggests that checking the file is…
items.why: Inferência: pedir para "take your time" mostra que checar é um passo cuidadoso e importante.

items.q: What can we say about the IT team from James's words?
options: It is small but quick and helpful
items.why: Inferência: "Our IT team is small, but we are very quick. You can always ask us."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Please save the file before you go home." To save means to…
options: keep your work on the computer
items.why: Save = salvar: guardar seu trabalho no computador.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "When the report is ready, please ___ it to your manager."
items.why: Send = enviar: mandar o arquivo para outra pessoa.

items.q: "Please open the document and read page two." To open means to…
options: make a file appear on the screen
items.why: Open = abrir: fazer o arquivo aparecer na tela.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I finished my work, so I will ___ the file and go home."
items.why: Close = fechar: encerrar o arquivo quando você termina.

items.q: "Can you share the file with the team?" To share means to…
options: give other people access to it
items.why: Share = compartilhar: dar acesso do arquivo a outras pessoas.

blocks.instruction: Expressões e phrasal verbs simples que aparecem no dia a dia da equipe de IT. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Please log in with your name and password." To log in means to…
options: enter the system with your account
items.why: Log in = entrar no sistema com seu usuário e senha.

items.q: "Remember to log out when you finish." To log out means to…
items.why: Log out = sair do sistema com segurança ao terminar.

items.q: "IT will back up the files every night." To back up means to…
options: make a safe copy of the files
items.why: Back up = fazer uma cópia de segurança dos arquivos.

items.q: "My computer is slow. Can you help out?" To help out means to…
items.why: Help out = dar uma ajuda, ajudar alguém com uma tarefa.

items.q: "The manager will sign off on the new plan tomorrow." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval final.
